note: Derivation (08-classes.md §3g): every hobby Chrome prospect autograph of 2020 Bowman (Chrome Prospect Autograph, CPA-, 62; released May 21 2020), 2020 Bowman Chrome (Chrome Prospect Autograph, CPA-, 75 lines for 73 cards; Sep 17 2020) and 2020 Bowman Draft (Chrome Autograph, CDA-, 118; Dec 8 2020) from Cardsmiths full checklists (Draft 118 also on Cardboard Connection), read Oct 30 2026, matched by accent-folded player name (Jr./II/III dropped) against every Chrome prospect auto list of 2016-2019 Bowman / Bowman Chrome / Bowman Draft (2019 and 2018 Chrome: Cardsmiths; 2016-2018 others: Cardboard Connection) and the earlier 2020 releases (2020 Bowman Sapphire BSPA- 57, Jul 7 2020). 4 rows have an earlier auto (Rutschman, Vaughn, Bleday, Greene - 2019 Bowman Draft CDAs) and are false; 5 held: Kevin Smith (name only, team differs), Colin Barber (first auto is the July Sapphire BSPA-CB, before his Sep Chrome CPA), and three Sapphire-only first autos (Rave, Waldichuk, Fitzgerald) - G61. 2020 Bowman Chrome Mega Box (early Oct 2020; Mojo autos BCMA-/BMA-, 25 lines read on Cardboard Connection): every signer outside the hobby lists has a 2019 Draft CDA - no Mega-only first auto. Open before universeComplete: (1) the May 2020 Mega Box auto set, 2020 Chrome Sapphire Edition and 2020 Draft Sapphire auto lists not found (Cardsmiths 404 / base only); (2) the 5 held rows (G61, name hold); (3) consoles patterned; (4) priors read back to 2016 only, and the 2016-2018 lists are one source (Cardboard Connection) each.
